q2_gaps: A bare MASS object carrying a descriptive modifier inside a generic rule ('gives weak mist-light'): the instruction set licenses a bare kind filler for non-specific/kind-level objects and a group witness for bare plurals, but says nothing about a mass object that needs an individuated bearer for its adjective - which is why the parse mints (sk_mistlight $d) to hang 'weak' on.
notes: Routing bare 'when P, Q' with indefinite participants onto the whenever rule, Patient on the drained lantern, Agent on the inanimate transitive subject and Theme on the given light all follow the instruction set. The Skolem stem sk_mistlight does not match its class symbol mist_light (cosmetic).
